nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 liquidity asset held in escrow by the FundingLocker.
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull or drain the escrowed liquidity asset.
FundingLocker constructor that sets the liquidityAsset and loan immutable addresses.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring a specified amount of liquidity asset to a destination.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring the full liquidity asset balance to the Loan.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the loan state variable before execution.
Caller address used in the isLoan modifier authorization check.
External ERC20 token transfer of amt to dst inside pull, which may invoke arbitrary token code.
External ERC20 token transfer of the full contract balance to the loan address inside drain.
Destination address parameter of pull for the liquidity asset transfer.
Amount of liquidity asset to transfer, parameter of pull.
Local variable holding the contract liquidity asset balance read in drain.
Constructor parameter used to initialize the liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter used to initialize the loan state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the loan address in the isLoan modifier require, gating privileged functionality.
The loan state variable is read inside isLoan to authorize the caller.
Constructor writes the _liquidityAsset parameter into the liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor writes the _loan parameter into the loan state variable.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset flows into the liquidityAsset assignment.
Constructor parameter _loan flows into the loan assignment.
pull executes the external safeTransfer token call, transferring control to the token contract mid-execution.
liquidityAsset is the token instance on which safeTransfer is invoked in pull.
The dst parameter is passed as the recipient of the token transfer in pull.
The amt parameter is passed as the amount of the token transfer in pull.
drain executes the external safeTransfer token call, transferring control to the token contract mid-execution.
liquidityAsset is the token instance used for the balance query and safeTransfer in drain.
The local amt balance is used as the transferred value in drain.
A malicious token contract could reenter pull during the safeTransfer external call.
A malicious token contract could reenter drain during the safeTransfer external call in pull.
A malicious token contract could reenter drain during its own safeTransfer external call.

normalization_plan.reason: The dst parameter exists solely to supply the recipient argument of the external token transfer in pull.
The amt parameter exists solely to supply the value argument of the external token transfer in pull.
The local amt holds the fetched liquidity asset balance that is directly forwarded to the loan in the drain transfer.
The constructor parameter only initializes the liquidityAsset state variable and has no independent behavior.
The constructor parameter only initializes the loan state variable and has no independent behavior.
